title: Move-Out
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:41 AM

Move-Out

Use

During the move-out transaction, you execute most of the activities required to cancel the customer's supply of utilities services.
You make changes to the business partner master data that result from a move-out. You specifically end the allocation of a
contract to an installation on the move-out date.

Move-out

Installation |

Move-out processing stops the active payment plans. A move-out confirmation letter and an immediate bill can also be triggered

from the move-out.

Prerequisites

You require one or more existing contracts with installations for the requested move-out date to create a move-out.

Features

Riidacat Rillingo Dian
